name: ctrl-c-detach-hint
description: In a window that owns its agent, the first Ctrl+C says a second press stops the agent and Ctrl+Z detaches; Ctrl+Z then leaves the agent running. Uses a scratch workspace so a developer's agents are never touched.

steps.pattern: Press Ctrl\+C again to stop \S+, or Ctrl\+Z to detach

steps.command: PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" sh -c 'cd /tmp/kollab-ctrlc-hint && kollab --hub status 2>&1 | grep -q "agent(s) online"'
